model: ML180UHE(X) series 80% upflow/horizontal gas furnace (ML180UH045E36A to ML180UH135E60D)
notes: Covers the ML180UHE(X) models from 44,000 to 132,000 Btuh input; the spec table lists each Low NOx (X) model number in the column of its standard model. Blower size, blower amps, wheel size, inducer orifice and pressure switch values differ by model, so match them to the full model number.

gaps: No blower run capacitor is claimed: none is mentioned for the DC brushless motor.
The spec table lists each Low NOx model number in the column of its standard model, so its values are read as shared. Tables 7 and 8 name only standard models, and ML180UH070E36A appears in neither.
The primary limit may have a different setpoint for each model number and none is printed, so none is claimed.
The gas valve make and model are not printed in the sources read, so none is named.
The only part numbers claimed are the two integrated control numbers (103217-03 and 107163-01); the manual gives no OEM numbers for the blower, valve, inducer, igniter or limits.
The page footer prints a 2016 copyright on the 04-2024 revision; no production years are claimed.
Table 8's second column heading prints as 'Break' followed by a plus sign underlined (plus or minus) and 0.05; it is written here with the plus-or-minus sign.
method: Lennox Unit Information, Service Literature, ML180UHE(X) Series Units, Corp 1120-L4 (04-2024), from lennox.com; pages 1, 2, 8, 9 and 14 to 18 used.
Pages 2 (spec tables) and 18 (table 8) were rendered as images and compared with the text layer; page 9's terminal table lists the indoor blower as 120VAC.
The Lennox engineering handbook and installation manual were not read.

comps.spec: DC brushless blower motor: output 1/2 hp (045E36A, 070E36A, 070E36B), 3/4 hp (090E48B), 1 hp (090E60C, 110E60C, 135E60D); full load amps 6.8 (045E36A, 070E36A, 070E36B), 8.4 (090E48B), 10.9 (090E60C, 110E60C, 135E60D); 120 V, 60 Hz, single phase
Blower wheel, nominal diameter x width: 10 x 8 in. (045E36A), 10 x 10 in. (070E36A, 070E36B, 090E48B), 11-1/2 x 10 in. (090E60C, 110E60C), 11 x 11 in. (135E60D)
Control transformer rated 40 VA, 120 V primary and 24 V secondary, in the control box
Internally redundant gas valve with inlet and outlet pressure taps and a regulator adjustment screw; 24 VAC terminals; LP changeover kits available from Lennox
Flame sensor on the left side of the burner support, its tip in the flame of the left-most burner; flame signal in DC microamps: normal 1.5 or greater, low 0.5 - 1.4, drop out 0.4 or less
Nitride ceramic hot-surface ignitor: a resistance of 39 to 70 ohms indicates a good ignitor; supply should be 120 VAC during the 20-second warm-up
Integrated furnace control (A92), listed with part numbers 103217-03 and 107163-01; not field repairable; red diagnostic LED and two accessory terminals rated at one amp
Flame rollout switch S47, normally-closed manual-reset limit with a factory setpoint of 210°F; two identical switches per furnace
Primary limit, automatic reset, in the heating vestibule panel under the combustion air inducer; may have a different setpoint for each model number
Door interlock switch S51, rated 14 A at 125 VAC, wired in series with line voltage
24 V circuit breaker CB8 protecting the transformer, rated 3 A at 32 V, with a reset button on its face
Combustion air inducer B6, 120 VAC motor; table 7 orifice size by model: 045E36A 1.063", 070E36B 1.316", 090E48B and 090E60C 1.531", 110E60C 1.690", 135E60D 1.940"
Duralok heat exchanger of aluminized steel
